question: What best explains the apparent FY2025-FY2026 GEO-linked DHS obligation acceleration?

hypotheses.title: Cross-facility operational funding and successor-task actions
hypotheses.description: The observed action totals are principally incremental funding, new/successor task actions, and bounded scope/capacity additions distributed across B.I. and multiple detention facilities.
hypotheses.falsification: Official transaction action types show options, corrections, or closeouts account for most of the net totals, or the same-elapsed increase disappears after exact action-date comparison.

hypotheses.title: Fiscal-year-end batching alone
hypotheses.description: The apparent increase is principally a September/fiscal-boundary artifact rather than a broader in-year funding pattern.
hypotheses.falsification: A large non-year-end cluster and same-elapsed increase survive outside September across multiple programs/facilities.

hypotheses.title: Option, deobligation, or correction accounting artifact
hypotheses.description: Explicit option exercises, reversals, corrections, or closeout entries create most of the apparent acceleration.
hypotheses.falsification: Those action types are a small share while funding-only and initial task actions dominate.

evidence.fact: September supplied 25.4681% of FY2025 net obligations and September 26-30 supplied 16.1476%.
January 21-28, 2026 supplied $262,845,644.26, or 40.5324% of FY2026-to-date net obligations, across seven facility/service categories.
FY2026 through July 9 was 25.1369% above the FY2025 same-elapsed window.
Funding-only plus new/base task actions accounted for 98.3474% of FY2025 net and 85.6478% of FY2026-to-date net.
The ICE subset contained one explicit FY2025 option action ($11,894,500 at Tacoma) and no FY2026 option action through July 9.
Gross deobligations were 0.8625% of FY2025 gross positive obligations and 0.4612% in FY2026 through July 9.
Positive same-elapsed contributors included ISAP V skip tracing, North Lake, Adelanto, Delaney Hall, Tacoma, and GEO Transport, while ISAP IV, South Texas, and Montgomery declined.
GEO's 2025 10-K separately reported an activation/transportation revenue bundle but stated that revenue-recognition timing may differ from invoicing.
Parent IDV snapshots generally show zero parent obligations while task orders carry obligations and outlays; parent potential value is therefore not the action flow.

verdict: H1 is least inconsistent as a bounded descriptive mechanism, not a political or service-demand causal finding. Fiscal timing materially affects FY2025, but it is insufficient by itself because the FY2026 concentration is in January and the same-elapsed increase survives. Explicit options and deobligation accounting do not explain most of the totals.
database_hypothesis_decision: No hypothesis was registered. The surviving mechanism is directly measured action classification, not an unexplained correlation requiring a new theory.
